value.rationale: Determines a natural affine invariant for all normalized p-by-q nonnegative Monge cost-matrix polytopes, with two unconstrained integer dimensions. The exact formula has a meaningful dimension-sensitive defect from the simplex bound, a constructive finite convex average of natural extreme points, and an exact positive duality identity. It addresses an invariant distinct from the motivating source’s face enumerations and volumes and is not merely a normalization change or a known-table computation.
